Option 1: "چنین رفت و این بودنی کار بود - از این خویشتن اکنون چه سود". Rough translation: "Thus it went and this was the state of affairs - what benefit now from this self?" It seems to reflect on futility, perhaps lament about past actions, questioning benefit of self after something happened. Could be about regret, self-reflection, perhaps about the futility of existence.

Option 2: "من خویشتن اسیر کمند نظر شدم - او را خود التفات نبودی به صید من". Translation: "I became captive of my own desire/eye (attention) - he/she did not even turn attention to my trap." So speaker is trapped by his own gaze/attention, but the other person doesn't notice. Theme: unrequited love, self-entrapped by desire, others indifferent.

Option 3: "چو با حکم قضا باید رضا داد - چو باید خورد هر کس آنچه قسمت گشت از روزی". Translation: "As with the decree of fate one must accept (be content) - as each must eat what portion was allotted from sustenance." So theme: acceptance of destiny, fatalism, contentment with one's lot.

Option 4: "نهنگی کو کشد ماهی به دریا - قضای آسمان باشد نه تدبیر". Translation: "A whale that drags fish into the sea - it is the decree of heaven not planning." Means that some events are due to divine decree, not human planning. Similar to fatalism.

So options 3 and 4 share theme of destiny/fate being beyond human control. Option 1 maybe about futility, maybe also about self-reflection but not necessarily about destiny. Option 2 about love/unrequited.
